decisions.decision: Do the prep now and touch nothing at any vendor. 1) Write ~/.config/tantra/ROTATION_PLAN.md (names and file paths only, never key values). For each of Kie.ai, the GoHighLevel FINTECH Circle token, Instantly and the Google OAuth 'Email Campaign' client, list every file, .env, Worker secret and centre setting that reads it. Grep ~/.config/tantra, ~/.config/kie/api-key, the app/.env.local files and the centre Worker secrets. 2) Check REVERT_LEDGER.md and remove anything already deleted. 3) Mark each key ROTATE (still used) or DELETE (unused). Instantly is off the approved stack, so expect DELETE. 4) For each key, write the exact dashboard URL and the files to update with the new value, so rotation after launch is one sitting. Then set the task back to held, blocked on launch (T-005 is the last task). Do not rotate, delete or create any key before then.
decisions.why: Owner rule (owner-launch-constraints, 2026-09-18): rotation only after launch. T-005 is still in queue, so launch has not happened. Making or deleting keys counts as creating credentials and a change to live vendor accounts (vendor-accounts-no-change-rule), which is not approvable now. The usage inventory is buildable prep.
